name: PrimeSpy
description_en:
PrimeSpy is an ad-research and competitor-tracking tool for finding creatives, reviewing advertisers and organizing ongoing monitoring. The site emphasizes Meta-library search and paid analytics for Meta and TikTok. Its filters include creative format, CTA, duplicates, reach and spend signals.

This is research on other advertisers’ visible activity, not access to their conversion ledger. Words such as winning describe the vendor’s positioning; an ad that runs for a long time or has estimated reach is not proven profitable. The useful output is a set of documented creative hypotheses to test independently.
description_zh:
PrimeSpy 用于广告研究与竞品跟踪，可查找素材、研究广告主并持续监测。官网重点描述 Meta 广告库搜索，以及付费的 Meta、TikTok 分析。筛选项包括素材形式、CTA、重复数、触达和支出信号。

它研究其他广告主的可见活动，无法因此取得对方转化账本。“获胜广告”属于厂商定位，投放时间长或有估算触达不证明盈利。更有用的产出是一组有证据的素材假设，再独立测试。

core_features.explanation_en: Search by keyword, URL or advertiser and use core Meta filters.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按关键词、URL 或广告主搜索，并使用 Meta 基础筛选。

core_features.explanation_en: Free entry lists two trackers; Pro lists twenty.
core_features.explanation_zh: 免费入口列两个跟踪器，Pro 列二十个。

core_features.explanation_en: Pro adds deeper Meta/TikTok analysis, saved-list export and creative downloads.
core_features.explanation_zh: Pro 增加 Meta／TikTok 深度分析、收藏列表导出与素材下载。

Research scope.en: Public documentation and commercial access reviewed; examples are proposed evaluation workflows.

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: Create an account, test one keyword and one tracker, and inspect credit consumption before expanding research. The exact per-operation credit schedule was linked but not established in the page text, so a team should budget from its real search and tracking pattern. Pro lists advanced EU filters and downloads, while AI Insights is marked Soon. This review did not log in, download any creative or verify a self-hosted distribution or open-source license.
steps.zh: 注册账户后测试一个关键词和一个跟踪器，查看积分消耗，再扩展研究。页面链接了积分细则，但正文未建立每种操作的积分表，因此团队应按实际搜索与跟踪方式估算。Pro 列高级欧盟筛选和下载，AI Insights 标为 Soon。本研究未登录、下载素材，也未确认自托管发行或开源许可。

items.en: PrimeSpy may suit creative strategists and ecommerce teams that need searchable references and monitoring. Meta’s own library is an adjacent option for direct ad discovery; PrimeSpy adds organization and analytical filters described by the vendor. Neither the reviewed page nor this research validates coverage completeness, deletion retention or the spend-estimation method. If a tracker returns no ad, investigate filters and coverage before concluding that a competitor stopped advertising.
items.zh: 需要可搜索参考和持续监测的创意策略、电商团队可评估 PrimeSpy。Meta 自带广告库是直接发现广告的相邻选择，PrimeSpy 增加厂商描述的整理与分析筛选。本次页面及研究未验证覆盖完整性、删除后保留或支出估算方法。跟踪器没有返回广告时，应先检查筛选与覆盖，不应直接断言竞品已停止投放。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The pricing page offers 500 free credits and two trackers without a card. Pro lists 20,000 credits and twenty trackers, with a visible $9.99/month equivalent alongside monthly/annual controls and an annual saving. The exact selected payment term is not unambiguous in extracted text. The FAQ says Pro is a one-time purchase for the chosen period and does not automatically renew; credits refresh per paid period. Running out of credits requires upgrading. Do not interpret initial free credits as a verified recurring free monthly allowance.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 定价页提供 500 个免费积分和两个跟踪器，无需信用卡。Pro 列 20,000 积分与二十个跟踪器，在月付／年付控件及年度节省旁展示每月 9.99 美元等值，但提取文字未明确当前选择的付款周期。FAQ 表示 Pro 为所选期间的一次性购买，不自动续费；积分按付费期间刷新。积分用尽需升级。初始免费积分不能解读成已确认每月循环赠送。

sections.title_en: Build a creative hypothesis from observed ads
sections.title_zh: 从观察广告建立素材假设
sections.en: For a proposed DTC launch, search an advertiser or product keyword, compare hooks and calls to action, and save a small set of references. Add a tracker to see whether the advertiser changes the creative or continues running it. Record dates and market filters with your notes. Use those observations to write an original test brief. Do not copy a competitor creative or treat visible ad duration, estimated spend or engagement as a verified return on ad spend.
sections.zh: 以 DTC 上新为假设，搜索广告主或产品词，比较开头卖点与行动号召，保存少量参考；增加跟踪器，观察广告主是否修改素材或继续投放。记录日期及市场筛选条件，再据此撰写原创测试简报。不要复制竞品素材，也不要把可见投放时长、估算支出或互动当作已核实的广告回报。
